title: Dimensions in Time (1)
best_reported: 576i broadcast, 26 November 1993; never released on any format, cast agreement and Children in Need licensing bar it
description: Several Doctors and their companions are pulled out of their own times and dropped into Albert Square, where the Rani has set a trap. The residents carry on as the travellers flicker between years around them.

title: Doctor Who: The Movie
description: The Doctor is carrying the Master's remains home to Gallifrey when the TARDIS is forced down in San Francisco, days before the millennium. A surgeon who has never seen two hearts is about to lose him, and the Master is already looking for a new body.

title: Doctor Who and the Curse of Fatal Death (1)
best_reported: 576i broadcast 12 March 1999; official VHS 6 September 1999 in two parts; no DVD; official YouTube upload is 854x480 native, its 720p and 1080p are YouTube AI upscales
description: The Master lures the Doctor to Tersurus for a final reckoning, having spent centuries arranging the sewers beneath it. Both keep going back to bribe the same architect, and the Doctor is expected at his own wedding.

title: Death Comes to Time (1)
best: SD webcast, MP3-CD only, no video disc
best_reported: RealAudio plus RealPix timed stills, 13 July 2001 to 3 May 2002; never video; the 2004 MP3-CD carried the webcast assets
source: archive.org doctor-who-bbci-webcasts-death-comes-to-time-real-time-shada | reconstruction of the RealAudio and RealPix slideshow; parts 1-3 are 640x360, parts 4-5 1280x720
description: The Doctor and Ace are drawn into a war in which Time Lords act openly as gods and one of them has taken a side. The rules the Doctor has lived by are being broken by his own people, and somebody is counting the cost.

title: Real Time (1)
best_reported: Flash/RealVideo webcast 2 August to 6 September 2002; never released on any format. Two reconstructions exist, 1280x720 and 640x360; the 720p is cleaner and is not the 360p doubled, but whether it is a better source or a denoised upscale is unproven
source: archive.org doctor-who-bbci-webcasts-death-comes-to-time-real-time-shada | 1280x720 reconstruction, chosen over the 640x360 copy which shows heavy MPEG blocking
description: A team investigating a derelict station finds the Cybermen midway through an experiment, converting rather than killing. The Sixth Doctor and Evelyn arrive in the middle of it, with the conversions already under way.

title: Scream of the Shalka (1)
best: 2160p, native render of the BBC Flash files, 2013 DVD audio and subtitles
best_reported: Flash webcast 13 November to 18 December 2003; DVD 16 September 2013 (576i, the better sound). The Flash files survive, so a native 4K render is the picture ceiling
source: archive.org ScreamoftheShalka4K | rendered from the BBC Flash files, 2013 DVD AC-3 and English VobSub muxed in
description: Called to the Lancashire town of Lannet, the Doctor finds the people cowed into silence and something burrowing beneath the streets. The Shalka rule by sound, and this Doctor travels with a Master of his own.
